name: retro
description: Guided experiment-loop retrospective over the ax agent-experience graph. Walks the user through their open proposals (accept-with-scaffold or reject), pending verdicts (confirm the suggested verdict or override), and recent harness-hook effectiveness signal. Triggers when the user says "let's do an ax retro", "ax retrospective", "review my ax proposals", "triage proposals", "experiment loop status", "lock pending verdicts", "hook effectiveness review", "intervention review", "self-improvement se
author: Necmttn
summary_zh: 用于复盘智能体实验闭环，引导处理待审提案与结论，并评估干预效果，适合持续改进智能体行为。
